description:
Recipe Scaler is a native, beautifully designed app for storing recipes and cooking with real convenience.

Save your favorite recipes in one place, quickly scale them to any number of servings, and cook without unnecessary calculations. Clean interface, smooth performance, and thoughtful details make everyday cooking simpler and more enjoyable.

Main features:
• Store and organize your recipes
• Instantly scale any recipe to the desired number of servings
• Helpful cooking assistant
• Full offline mode
• Seamless sync across devices
• Easy recipe sharing

Deep iOS integration:
• Home Screen Widgets
• Live Activities
• Push Notifications
• Spotlight Search

Built natively for iPhone — fast, polished, and a pleasure to use every day.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
keywords: recipe storage,recipe scaler,cooking assistant,save recipes,meal prep,cooking app,recipe manager
promotionalText: Store and scale your recipes, cook with ease. Adjust servings, save favorites, work offline and sync across devices. Native, beautiful and convenient.
